title: Near-top odd defects anti-cluster: u(x)>=p implies u(T(x))<=f(p)<0.988
statement: On successive dynamically relevant odd Juggler states, u(x)>=p forces u(T(x))<=f(p) with a scale-stable gap f(p)<0.988, so the run-type finance extremum is unattainable on E_run(10^6), in particular at L=55293.
counterexamples: In [10^6+1, 3e6) there are 2420 OO pairs with u>=0.995 and f(0.995)=0.999958. Twelve pairs have both coordinates >=0.995
Among 576 pairs with u>=0.999, f(0.999)=0.9936>0.988, so even the extreme tail does not cut L=55293
mathematical_domain: Juggler cycle finance / successive floor defects
notes: Sharpening of juggler_cycle_defect_correlation_leftover_killer. u, delta, lambda are the same rho. No phases 2-13. No Paper A edit, no ledger row, no Lean. Not a halt theorem.
tested_range: OO/OE f(p) on [10^6+1, 10^6+20001) and oe_start window; high-u followup on [10^6+1, 3e6) and [10^7+1, 10^7+400001)
